model: Broker FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity (bank-style, net debt held at zero, engine route), earnings retention for net-capital growth as the reinvestment charge, perpetual-bond distributions charged in the flow

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case medium-term revenue growth (FY2029-30), not a historical CAGR
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are FY2022->FY2025 (3yr) and FY2020->FY2025 (5yr). Reported equity CAGR (12.9%/12.7%) is inflated by RMB25bn of perpetual-bond issuance (2021-23) and the 2023 convertible conversion (+797m shares); ordinary book value PER SHARE (ex-perpetuals) compounded 8.0%/7.4%, and that is the number to compare with revenue (10.1%/8.8%) and EPS (13.7%/7.7%) -- no >30% divergence. FCF CAGRs are null: reported FCF is negative in FY2023-25 and sign-flips with client balances, so a CAGR is undefined and meaningless for a broker; ordinary net income (FY2020 7.2bn -> FY2025 ~11.6bn after coupons, ~10%/yr) is the earnings series. Ordinary ROE FY2021-25: ~12.8 / 8.6 / 7.8 / 8.6 / 10.2% (FY2026E ~10.8%), average ~9.6%, below the 11% cost of equity in most years -- which is why fair value sits below ordinary book. BVPS CAGR is not used as the growth selector because it reflects a ~70% retention ratio at sub-CoE ROE (capital accumulation), not distributable-earnings growth.

scenario_narratives.base: Cycle normalises, franchise intact. FY2027 revenue resets ~8% below the FY2026E peak as A-share turnover and investment gains revert while the margin book keeps growing; pre-tax margin 33-34% (FY2021-25 average 32.7%); retention glides from 60% to 35% of ordinary profit as the payout rises from today's 30% toward two-thirds; terminal ordinary ROE ~8-9% versus an 11% cost of equity. The axes are (1) A-share turnover and the mark-to-market on a RMB400bn+ financial-asset book, (2) whether Huijin-controlled Galaxy lifts its payout as CSRC guidance intends, and (3) the ~RMB1bn/yr perpetual coupon that sits ahead of ordinary holders.
scenario_narratives.bull: Upcycle holds. Household savings keep rotating into A shares and long-term-capital reforms sustain turnover; FY2027 grows on the FY2026 base, margin settles at 37%, ordinary ROE ~11-12% clears the cost of equity and the H share re-rates toward ordinary book (CNY 11.04 = HKD 13.0). Requires the market to hold its gains AND the payout to roughly double -- two independent things going right.
scenario_narratives.bear: Rally reverses and consolidation bites. Turnover halves, investment gains fall to FY2022-23 levels with mark-to-market losses on an enlarged trading book, impairments rise on the margin/stock-pledge books; FY2027 revenue -25%, margin 26-30%, ordinary ROE ~6-7%; enlarged rivals (Guotai Haitong, CICC) take institutional share. Solvency is not the bear case (risk-coverage and net-capital ratios are strong, Huijin/CIC control), earnings power is.

valuation_philosophy.summary: China Galaxy is a state-controlled (Huijin/CIC) full-service Chinese securities firm whose value is the stream of distributable earnings to ORDINARY shareholders, capitalised at an 11% CNY cost of equity. Reported operating cash flow is noise (client money, margin loans, repo and trading positions), so the model discounts FCFE = after-tax profit less perpetual-bond distributions less earnings retained to grow net capital. Ordinary ROE has averaged ~9.6% over FY2021-25 against an 11% cost of equity, so fair value sits below ordinary book (CNY 11.04/share) in the base and bear cases; the bull case needs ROE to clear the cost of equity AND the 30% payout to rise materially. FY2026E is struck near a cyclical high and the base case resets revenue and margin in FY2027 rather than extrapolating. Perpetual bonds (RMB34.9bn) are charged via their coupon, not deducted at face; the alternative is quantified in inputs.perpetual_treatment. The H share's ~49% discount to the A share is reported but not modelled as a cash-flow item.
key_risks_to_valuation: A-share turnover and index levels: fee income (+48% YoY in H1 2026) and investment gains (34% of FY2025 revenue) are directly cyclical; a reversal takes revenue back to the FY2023-24 band (bear case).

Payout policy: the 30% payout is the single biggest lever on FCFE; the base case assumes it roughly doubles over ten years under CSRC guidance. If Galaxy keeps retaining ~70% at sub-CoE ROE, value is materially lower than the base case.
Perpetual subordinated bonds (RMB34.9bn, ~RMB1.0bn/yr coupon) rank ahead of ordinary holders; further issuance to replenish net capital would dilute ordinary FCFE.
Credit and market risk on the margin-financing, stock-pledge and proprietary books (total assets RMB1.06tn on RMB156bn equity, +24% in six months).
Industry consolidation (Guotai Haitong, CICC) and fee compression eroding share in investment banking and institutional business.
Currency: value is built in CNY and translated at 1.1748 CNY/HKD; the HKD IV moves one-for-one with the RMB.
A/H discount (~49%) may persist indefinitely; the model does not assume it closes.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for 6881.HK at inputs.price_as_of (regular HKEX close); 52-week range 6.60-12.30. A-share parity from 601881.SS on the same date; CNY/HKD from CNYHKD=X.
data_sources.financials: research/6881.HK/Reports/6881.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, FY2018-H1 FY2026, RMB m) and the filings in research/6881.HK/Extracted/: 2026 interim report (income statement line 4505-4545, equity line 4673-4678, EPS/perpetual note line 5550-5590, Note 37 line 6421-6470, market trends line 655-690, outlook line 1246-1280), FY2025 annual report (revenue mix line 2138-2178, dividend/payout line 3960-3980, other equity instruments line 2816), FY2020-FY2024 annual reports for perpetual balances and revenue history.
data_sources.qualitative: 6881.HK_Analysis.json was not yet present when this valuation was built (written concurrently); scenario axes are drawn from the interim report's MD&A (market trends, industry landscape, H2 2026 outlook) and the FY2025 annual report.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E total revenue, gains and other income (IFRS gross basis: commission and fee income + interest income + investment income and gains + other), RMB m. H1 2026 actual 22,323 (+18.8% YoY; fee +47.9%, interest +15.3%, investment gains +3.3% -- interim income statement line 4524) + H2 2026E ~21,000 (H2 2025 actual = 38,338 - 18,798 = 19,540; held ~+7% YoY and below the H1 run-rate: fee income tracks A-share turnover, which is NOT extrapolated at the H1 record pace). FY2025 actual 38,338, FY2024 34,048, FY2023 30,070, FY2022 28,727, FY2021 31,622 (prior cycle peak). No Q3 2026 report is in the folder yet (due ~late Oct 2026) -- it is the first evidence that would move this anchor.
inputs.share_count_basis: 10,934,402 thousand A + H ordinary shares at 30 Jun 2026 (interim line 496 'Total share capital'); weighted average = period-end (EPS note line 5558); interim Note 1 (line 503): no dilutive potential ordinary shares in 2025 or H1 2026, basic = diluted. Up from 10,137.3m through FY2022 on the 2023 convertible-bond conversion (797,122,580 shares, FY2023 AR line 3831). One class with identical economic rights, so the per-share value applies to the H share. Held FLAT: no options or convertibles outstanding; SBC-zero; ShareRepurchases nil FY2018-H1 2026.
inputs.debt_cash_note: Securities firm: bonds payable, short-term financing payables, repo obligations and borrowings (core_metrics total_debt RMB230.8bn at 30 Jun 2026; 195.9bn at FY2025) fund the margin-financing book, the proprietary trading book and client-driven products -- operating funding of a leveraged financial intermediary, not a claim to subtract from an equity flow. Own cash RMB30.1bn is working liquidity; accounts payable to brokerage clients (RMB334.8bn, +50% in H1 2026) are matched by segregated client deposits. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route (house convention: 6099.HK, 1788.HK, 2016.HK, 0998.HK); nothing is bridged after the flows. Gross figures stay in core_metrics for the reader.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE (distributable earnings to ORDINARY shareholders), not reported OCF - capex: FY2026E PBT ~16,675 (H1 actual 9,224 + H2E ~7,450; H2 2025 was 6,778) x (1 - 15% income tax) = NI ~14,175, less perpetual-bond distributions ~1,000 = ~13,175 to ordinary holders, less ~60% retained (~7,900) to grow net capital = ~5,300 (vs the FY2025 ordinary dividend of RMB3,827m at a 30.6% payout, FY2025 AR line 3972). reported_fcf is FY2025 reported OCF - capex (-25,514 - 844 = -26,358); OCF swings from +28.8bn (FY2022) to -30.2bn (FY2023) and -35.6bn (H1 2026) with client balances, margin loans, repo and trading-book positions and is NOT an earnings proxy, so the owner-FCF identity (reported - SBC - interest income) is deliberately not applied on this route.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest income (RMB13.6bn FY2025, 7.6bn H1 2026) is operating revenue of a margin lender and is kept INSIDE the revenue base; it is not the surplus-cash interest the owner-FCF rule strips, and no cash is added back in a bridge, so it is counted once.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: no share-based payment expense in the cash-flow reconciliation or the staff-costs note (FY2018-H1 2026); EquityAwardTaxes and ShareRepurchases both 0 in kpis. House and street bases coincide; band_position collapses.
inputs.fx_note: CNY -> HKD 1.1748 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-23). Statements are in RMB thousands (interim statement header line 4511); the H share quotes in HKD. Per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by fx_rate to the HKD quote. Parity check: the A share 601881.SS closed at CNY 11.63 on 2026-10-23 = HKD 13.66, so the H share at inputs.price_as_of trades at a ~49% discount to the A share and at ~0.53x ordinary book (CNY 11.04/share) -- a large but typical A/H discount for a state-controlled broker; the model values the ordinary share's cash flows and does not attempt to arbitrate the discount.
inputs.fy0_note: FY0 is an estimate (H1 2026 actual + H2 2026E); the first forecast year is FY2027. Dec year-end.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity 11.0% in CNY, the flows' own currency: 10-year CGB yield 1.73% at 30 Jun 2026 (interim line 666) + China equity risk premium ~7% x beta ~1.3 for a leveraged securities firm (gearing ratio 78.5%, total assets RMB1.06tn on RMB156bn equity) = ~10.8%, rounded to 11.0% and matched to the sibling broker 6099.HK (CoE 11% CNY) so the two are comparable. The 49% A/H discount is NOT loaded into the rate (risk charged once; the discount is a liquidity/segmentation phenomenon, not a cash-flow risk). Same rate in all three scenarios; risk is carried in the driver paths and the weights.
inputs.lease_treatment: Leases left in the P&L: depreciation of right-of-use assets and lease interest (RMB23m H1 2026, line 5466) sit inside total expenses and therefore inside the pre-tax margin; lease liabilities (RMB1.4bn) are not added to net debt. One treatment, no double count.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests are RMB16m of RMB155.7bn equity and RMB0.2m of RMB7.8bn H1 2026 profit (<0.01%); the flow is attributable profit and no NCI deduction is made.
inputs.perpetual_treatment: RMB34.9bn of perpetual subordinated bonds sit in 'Other equity instruments' at 30 Jun 2026 (interim Note 37, line 6429; 29.9bn at FY2025; 15.9bn FY2022; 5.0bn FY2020). Ordinary book = 155,703 - 34,943 = RMB120,760m = RMB11.04/share (company's own figure, interim Note 2 line 506) vs the headline 14.24. Treated as DEBT-LIKE: the distribution (~RMB1.0bn/yr forward: 15bn 2023 tranches at 3.43-3.63% + 20bn 2025-26 tranches at 2.00-2.40%; H1 2026 charge RMB536m, 2025 distribution RMB863m) is charged in the flow via the cash_tax_rate_path, so the FCFE is to ORDINARY shareholders and the valuation is of the ordinary share. The alternative -- deducting the RMB34.9bn at face from equity value -- would be RMB3.20/share (HKD 3.75) lower; it is not used because the coupons are already charged (face deduction + coupon charge would double count) and the instruments are callable at the company's option (the 2021 tranches were redeemed at par in Mar/Apr 2026).
inputs.notes: MODEL: broker FCFE capitalised at cost of equity, run through the engine with net_debt = 0 (SKILL.md routes banks/brokers away from owner-FCF; precedent 6099.HK China Merchants Securities, 1788.HK). Reported OCF is dominated by client-money, margin-loan and trading-book swings (-35.6bn H1 2026) and cannot be discounted. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = total revenue, gains and other income (gross IFRS basis); ebitda_margin_path = PRE-TAX profit margin (interest expense, staff costs, impairments and D&A are all inside it; da_pct = 0 so EBIT = EBITDA); cash_tax_rate_path = income tax + perpetual-bond distributions as a share of PBT, so NOPAT = profit to ORDINARY shareholders; capex_pct_path = earnings RETAINED to grow net capital (not PP&E capex, which is RMB0.2-0.8bn/yr and immaterial); wc_capture_pct = 0; FCF = distributable earnings to ordinary shareholders (FCFE). Terminal value = Gordon FCFE at CoE 11% less g, capped at 15x. The dashboard's 'EBITDA margin' slider is therefore the pre-tax margin and the 'capex' slider is retention. IDENTITY CHECK (financial-parser brief): statements in RMB; H-share of China Galaxy Securities (controller Central Huijin / CIC), NOT China Everbright Securities (6178.HK) -- every filing header reads 'China Galaxy Securities Co., Ltd.'. CYCLE: FY2026E is struck near a cyclical high (H1 2026 PBT margin 41.3% vs FY2021-25 average 32.7%; A-share STAR 50 +64%, ChiNext +36% YTD at 30 Jun 2026), and the base case resets revenue and margin in FY2027 rather than extrapolating.

bear.growth_rationale: The rally reverses: A-share turnover halves from the H1 2026 record, fee income falls back to the FY2024 level, investment gains drop to the FY2022-23 level (~RMB5-8bn) with mark-to-market losses on the enlarged trading book, margin balances shrink and credit impairments rise; FY2027 revenue ~RMB32.5bn (the FY2023-24 band of 30-34bn), a further -3% in FY2028 as consolidated rivals (Guotai Haitong, enlarged CICC) take underwriting and institutional share, then 2-2.5% nominal.
bear.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin falls to the FY2022-23 trough (27-28%) and below as funding cost on a 24%-larger balance sheet, credit impairments on the margin and stock-pledge books and fee compression bite; partial recovery to 30% as costs are cut.
bear.capex_rationale: Retention ~65% of ordinary profit in FY2027 (13.0% of revenue at a 27% margin x 74%) -- the dividend is cut in RMB terms but a ~35% payout is defended -- gliding to ~40% = terminal g 2.5% / terminal ordinary ROE ~6.3% (below the FY2023 trough of 7.8%). Terminal P/B ~0.45x ordinary book.
bear.tax_rationale: Income tax ~14.5% + fixed ~RMB1.0bn perpetual coupon against a ~8.8bn PBT (~11.5%) = 26%, easing to 24% as PBT recovers.
bear.terminal_note: Gordon 1.025/0.085 = 12.1x FCFE; cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~0.45x ordinary book.
bear.narrative: Rally reverses and consolidation bites: revenue falls 25% to the FY2023-24 band, margin 26-30%, ordinary ROE ~6-7% well below the cost of equity; fair value is under half of ordinary book.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 -8% to ~RMB39.8bn: fee income eases from the H1 2026 record A-share turnover (fee +48% YoY in H1), investment gains revert from ~RMB14bn FY2026E toward RMB11-12bn (FY2024-25 level on a larger book), interest income keeps growing with the margin-financing book and the 50% jump in client balances. Still +4% on FY2025 because turnover, margin balances and the trading book are structurally larger than in FY2024. Then +3% as the cycle settles, +4% through the mid-years (wealth management, 'long-term capital' institutional services, international integration, consolidation of share toward leading state-owned firms) fading to 3% nominal.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin: FY2021 40.4%, FY2022 27.7%, FY2023 27.0%, FY2024 30.9%, FY2025 37.6%, FY2026E ~38.5% (H1 41.3%). Base resets to 34% in FY2027 and holds 33-34%, above the FY2021-25 average of 32.7% because interest expense (RMB4.8bn/half) is largely fixed against a bigger revenue base and the mix has shifted toward fee and custody income, but below FY2025-26 because staff-cost accruals and impairment reversals do not repeat at trough turnover.
base.capex_rationale: Earnings retained to grow net capital and the balance sheet. FY2027 15.8% of revenue = 60% of ordinary profit (26.4% of revenue at a 34% margin x 77.5%); actual FY2024-25 retention was ~69% (payout 30.5-30.6%, FY2025 AR line 3972). Glides to 9.3% = ~35% of ordinary profit, i.e. payout rises to ~65% as CSRC dividend guidance, a slower-growing balance sheet and ample net capital (perpetuals replenish supplementary capital) free up earnings. Terminal retention 35% at ~8-9% ordinary ROE supports ~3% growth. FY2027 FCFE ~RMB4.2bn vs the FY2025 ordinary dividend of RMB3.8bn.
base.tax_rationale: Income tax ~15% (FY2025 13.1%, H1 2026 15.5%; FY2023-24's 3-5% excluded as unrepresentative) + NCI ~0% + perpetual-bond distributions ~RMB1.0bn on RMB35bn (~7.4% of a ~13.5bn FY2027 PBT, falling to ~5.5% as PBT grows) = 22.5% gliding to 21%. Charges the perpetual coupon in the flow so NOPAT is profit to ORDINARY shareholders.
base.terminal_note: Gordon on FY2036 FCFE at 11.0% - 3.0% = 12.9x; 15x cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~0.65-0.7x of ordinary book on ~8% terminal ordinary ROE, consistent with (ROE - g)/(CoE - g).
base.narrative: Cycle normalises, franchise intact: revenue resets 8% below the FY2026 peak, pre-tax margin 33-34%, balance sheet grows 3-4% on retained earnings and the payout drifts up from 30% toward two-thirds. Terminal ordinary ROE ~8-9% against an 11% cost of equity, so fair value sits at ~0.65x ordinary book.

bull.growth_rationale: The China capital-markets upcycle persists through FY2027 (household savings rotating into equities, long-term-capital reforms, STAR/ChiNext issuance pipeline, Huijin backing), so FY2027 grows 3% on the FY2026E level, then 4-5% as wealth management AUM, institutional/market-making and the international business compound and industry concentration favours the largest state-owned firms.
bull.margin_rationale: Operating leverage of a sustained upcycle: 39% in FY2027 (between FY2025 37.6% and H1 2026 41.3%), settling at 37%, roughly the FY2025 level; AI-driven cost-to-serve gains in the 'internet branches' offset fee compression.
bull.capex_rationale: Retention 52% of ordinary profit in FY2027 (16.0% of revenue at a 39% margin x 79%) gliding to 30% = terminal g 3.5% / terminal ordinary ROE ~11.5% (the FY2021 peak-cycle ROE of ~12.8% approached but not matched). Payout rises to 70%.
bull.tax_rationale: Income tax ~15% + fixed ~RMB1.0bn perpetual coupon on a larger PBT (~6% falling to ~5%).
bull.terminal_note: Gordon 1.035/0.075 = 13.8x FCFE; cap does not bind. Implied terminal P/B ~1.0x ordinary book.
bull.narrative: Upcycle holds: FY2027 grows on the FY2026 peak, margin settles at 37%, ordinary ROE ~11-12% clears the cost of equity and the H share re-rates toward ordinary book.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (above the 15% house default): the valuation is struck near a cyclical earnings high (H1 2026 pre-tax margin 41% vs a 33% five-year average), fee income is a direct function of A-share turnover, and state-directed consolidation has produced larger rivals; but solvency is not in question (Huijin/CIC control, 78% gearing within regulatory norms, perpetuals replenishing net capital) and Galaxy's H1 2026 growth was fee- and interest-led rather than mark-to-market-led (investment gains only +3% YoY, vs +213% at 6099.HK), so the bear weight is held below the 30% used for that sibling. Bull 25%: policy support for the capital markets is explicit and the H share already trades at 0.53x ordinary book with a ~5.9% trailing yield, but the bull case needs both the market to hold its gains and the payout to roughly double. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
